Capacitor layouts. Choose one by the capacitor style you need.

## `interdigital_capacitor`

An interdigital capacitor (IDC) with symmetric CPW terminal extensions and a derived etch. Its ports are the outer CPW cut planes.

![Default layout of `interdigital_capacitor`.](../../_static/images/components/interdigital_capacitor.svg)

Details: [Component guide](../../public-pdk-examples/components/interdigital_capacitor.qmd) · [Function reference](../../reference/cells.interdigital_capacitor.qmd)

## `martinis2022_differential_ribbon_capacitor`

The differential ribbon capacitor layout of Fig. 7 in Martinis 2022.

![Default layout of `martinis2022_differential_ribbon_capacitor`.](../../_static/images/components/martinis2022_differential_ribbon_capacitor.svg)

Details: [Component guide](../../public-pdk-examples/components/martinis2022_differential_ribbon_capacitor.qmd) · [Function reference](../../reference/cells.martinis2022_differential_ribbon_capacitor.qmd)
